mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a growing economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where the federal funds rate is above 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in strong labor markets are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and a decrease in the unemployment rate signal a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where industrial production is declining.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate and an increase in the consumer price index signal a tightening monetary cycle and high inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high federal funds rates and high inflation (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment and a decrease in the unemployment rate signal a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in strong labor markets are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales and a decrease in housing starts signal a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of low retail sales and low housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).
